step1.title: Welcome to Soma!
step1.desc: Soma is an AI-powered short video generator. Just enter a topic, and it automatically generates the script, voiceover, collects footage, adds subtitles, and composes the final video.
step1.prereqTitle: Make sure these dependencies are installed before running:

step2.title: Step 1: Configure an AI Model
step2.desc: Soma requires a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate video scripts and extract keywords. Here are 3 free options that need no API Key:
step2.freeTitle: 💡 Free options: Choose Ollama (local) or Pollinations (online free) — no API Key needed!
step2.tip: After choosing an LLM, fill in the API Key and model name in Settings → LLM Configuration. Free options need no key.

step3.title: Step 2: Configure Voice, Stock Source & Video Gen AI
step3.ttsDesc: Edge TTS is used by default (free, no key needed), supporting Chinese/English/multi-language voices. For higher quality, configure a paid TTS:
step3.stockDesc: Soma searches and downloads video clips from stock libraries. Apply for at least one free API key:
step3.aivideoDesc: Video generation models can directly produce video clips from text/images, different from the "stock search & stitch" mode. If not configured, Soma still works with stock libraries.
step3.aivideoFreeTip: 💡 Recommended: Zhipu CogVideoX — flash model is completely free, with the most mature API!

step4.title: Step 3: Fill in Settings
step4.desc: After getting your API keys, configure Soma following these steps:
step4.navSettingsDesc: Go to the Settings page where all configuration is centralized.
step4.setLlmDesc: Select Provider → Enter API Key → Confirm model name (leave empty for default).
step4.setStock: Fill in Stock Source API Key
step4.setStockDesc: Enter at least one stock library API key (Pexels recommended, free to apply).
step4.setTtsDesc: Default Edge TTS needs no config. For other TTS engines, fill in the corresponding API key.
step4.setAiVideoDesc: In the "AI Video Generation" card, expand the provider panel, fill in the API Key and select a model. Recommended: Zhipu CogVideoX (flash model is free).
step4.saveDesc: Config is saved to the backend and persists after restart.
step4.homeTipTitle: 💡 You can also configure on the Home page
step4.homeTip: The "API Key Management" panel on the right side of the Home page lets you quickly add stock keys without going to Settings.

step5.title: Step 4: Generate Your First Video
step5.desc: Once configured, head back to the Home page and start creating:
step5.inputTopicDesc: In "Script Settings", enter a topic like "History of AI", then click "Generate Script & Keywords".
step5.genScriptDesc: AI will generate a voiceover script and stock search keywords. You can manually edit after generation.
step5.adjustParamsDesc: Choose aspect ratio (9:16/16:9), voice, subtitle style, etc.
step5.clickGenerateDesc: Soma will automatically run: Script → Voiceover → Stock → Subtitles → Compose. Takes about 2-5 minutes.
step5.waitResultDesc: Check progress in "Task List". Preview or download the finished video when complete.
step5.readySub: You now know the basics of Soma. Start creating!
